description: Latest hourly fine particulate (PM2.5) reading in ug/m3 at the nearest working Defra AURN monitor, plus its 24-hour mean and the Daily Air Quality Index band and health advice that mean gives. PM2.5 is the pollutant most linked to health effects (smoke, wood burners, traffic, bonfire night), so this suits asthma and COPD sufferers, runners and parents. Source: Defra UK-AIR. Not a forecast; one monitor may not represent your street. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude of the place (UK, 49 to 61)

lon.description: number, required, longitude of the place (UK, -9 to 2.5)

max_km.description: number, optional, furthest monitor to use in km, default 25, max 100

name: pm25_level_near
